programme.title: Cougar
programme.desc: Donna and her young college son Brandon live in a nice suburban area of Atlanta, until a new and mysterious older woman moves in next door. Donna invites her over to dinner where she and Brandon connect, and build a connection that is deadly and manipulative. A mother must save her son before it’s too late.

programme.title: Back and Forth
programme.desc: Pier and Jade found love though the emotions of skating. Love was built but trust was lost, as deep secrets unfold, back and forth between the UK and USA. Having her heart broken, Jade took her fate in her own hands. It was only a matter of time, that the only plan left was to take revenge.

programme.title: How Did We Get Here
programme.desc: Four struggling couples attend a wellness retreat led by Dr. Sellers. Melonie and Derrick struggle with issues of infidelity, Omar and Sonya struggle with commitment, Chastity and Monae have differing opinions on parenthood, and Stephanie and Delvin are struggling with their intimacy. As the couples dive into their treatment, they must confront their own demons to move forward. Will they make it out together? Or go their separate ways?

programme.title: The New Girl
programme.desc: When her sister Monica suddenly disappears under suspicious circumstances, Malorie becomes convinced that Monica’s seemingly perfect husband is hiding something sinister. She then launches her own investigation and unearths a twisted web of lies, abuse, and even political conspiracy. Malorie must confront dangerous secrets that not only threaten her sister’s life but her own.

programme.title: The Forsaken
programme.desc: After discovering an old book, Alex becomes drawn into the harrowing stories of cowboys Latt and Stylz. As he reads about their treasure hunt and daring adventures, Alex finds inspiration in their courage and friendship to use in his own life and help him find the strength to overcome his own obstacles.

programme.title: Transcend
programme.desc: Maranda spent her life looking for a protector, only to find herself lost in a cycle of toxic love and betrayal. From the wreckage of abandonment to a life-altering crossroads, her survival isn't just about escaping the past, it’s about surviving herself.

programme.title: Murder on the Pole
programme.desc: One night Bunny was the queen of the dance floor; the next, she was a chalk outline. Dismissed by a department eager to sweep a "club girl's" death under the rug, Lola refuses to let her sister’s killer walk free. To find the murderer, Lola must infiltrate the world that claimed Bunny’s life—a world of predatory regulars, backstage betrayals, and a cover-up that goes higher than she ever imagined.

programme.title: The Loyalty Test
programme.desc: Trey Harrison is an up-and-coming internet star that has created a series exposing cheaters in orchestrated sting operations, successfully turning heartbreak into a viral spectacle. But when two participants are found murdered, Trey’s world begins to crumble and things only begin to escalate.

programme.title: Something Old
programme.desc: With her wedding days away, Kara agrees to meet her ex, Malik, for what she swears is just one last goodbye. But Malik isn’t looking for closure—he wants her back, and he’s not taking no for an answer. What starts as a simple meetup at a hotel turns into a dangerous game of obsession and control. As Kara’s fiancé Jordan uncovers the truth with help from her maid of honor, time’s running out.

programme.title: Camera Girl
programme.desc: After witnessing Atlanta’s underground rap scene firsthand, a quiet but driven young woman buys her first camera and sets out to become a music videographer. But as she fights for recognition, she’s pulled into a harsh world where talent is exploited and credit is stolen. Forced to choose between giving up or betting on herself, she risks everything to turn her passion into a career.

programme.title: The Sermon
programme.desc: When a charismatic pastor’s sermons begin to influence a group of men searching for purpose, their actions evolve into a series of calculated crimes carried out in the name of righteousness.

programme.title: Why Not You
programme.desc: Young executive Quincy Jackson finds himself at odds with his current girlfriend, when he discovers his coworker Joi is in a similar situation of her own. As they bond over their relationship troubles, their fates become intertwined.

programme.title: Teacher's Pet
programme.desc: A young and charming student enters a new school, but he has a way to get what he wants, including manipulating his teacher. When she tries to end their inappropriate relationship, people start to die around her. Will she make it out of this relationship alive?

programme.title: Sweet Mahogany 3: The Final Entanglement
programme.desc: The lives of Mahogany Andrews and those around her are drastically changed after devastating news changes relationships and reveals dark secrets from the past that will have a major impact on everyone’s future.

programme.title: Shuttered Secrets
programme.desc: When Trey’s ex-girlfriend, Jada, unexpectedly shows up to his studio, she accuses him of dark secrets and being involved in a missing persons case. Their reunion quickly spirals into psychological warfare and violence. As the night goes on, the line between predator and victim blurs when other mysterious figures arrive and everything must be questioned.

programme.title: Crush
programme.desc: Haunted by her past, a young woman's life is complicated by love, self-discovery, and surrounding violence.

programme.title: Too Much Too Soon
programme.desc: Justin runs an auto body shop, and everything seems on track until he meets Monique, an independent freelance artist. Despite being from two different worlds, they have an instant connection and it feels like the start of something real. When Justin is shot one night, it puts his future, and his connection with Monique to the test. Will love truly be enough to make them last?

programme.title: Repay it in Blood
programme.desc: Ten years after a robbery left their sister dead and their father broken, prosecutor Larissa and her sister Maritza, a top trauma nurse, are done waiting for justice. But just as the sisters begin targeting the crew responsible for that bloody night, the truth becomes deadlier than they anticipated.

programme.title: Thick Trip
programme.desc: Four close-knit friends, all single and yearning for a change, embark on a summer-long 'Queen's Trip' to South Padre, Houston, and the untouched wilderness. As they travel and experience the vibrant cultures and breathtaking landscapes, they confront their fears, rediscover their passions, and explore their own wild sides.

programme.title: The House on Adams Drive
programme.desc: Sean is convinced the only way to keep the woman of his dreams happy is by obtaining as much money as possible. His friend Kordell, who’s an adult film star, helps him with a way to make a lot of money overnight. When they’re sent to a house to possibly film a scene, that turns out to be a real life exorcism.

programme.title: For You I Will
programme.desc: Mikayla is a struggling hopeless romantic. When she meets Jalen, she thinks she’s found the one, but he wants a possession over a partner. He demands her loyalty by asking her for a hit list of all of her ex-boyfriends to secure his love. Will she walk away? Or let her desperation consume her and fall into a deadly trap?

programme.title: Stalked
programme.desc: Malachi, a talented but struggling artist and Kiana, an aspiring model leaves Philadelphia for Atlanta seeing better opportunities, and together the two’s careers begin to take off. But when Malachi meets Shante, her seductive charm and beauty pull him in, and her obsession threatens to destroy everything he and Kiana have built together.

programme.title: Hated By Many Loved By None
programme.desc: After a violent robbery and a shocking betrayal from her incarcerated husband, Jahzara is forced to fend for herself in a world she was never meant to lead. With her closest friends, Tomeka and Honey, by her side, she steps into the drug game, determined to rebuild her life. But as money, power, and new connections take over, loyalty quickly turns into betrayal.

programme.title: The Last Eyewitness
programme.desc: After a violent money exchange in a remote forest leaves several people dead, Riley becomes the only witness to a ruthless crime boss's return. Hunted through the wilderness, she must outlast her pursuers to survive.

programme.title: Contusion
programme.desc: Terry and his grandmother enjoy a life of peace and harmony, until one night when a group of thieves invade their home. As he navigates from the aftermath, he must confront whether justice will prevail or whether darkness will consume everything he holds dear.

programme.title: The Lies We Tell but the Secrets We Keep: The Last Lie
programme.desc: Obstacles derail Roni and Bri's attempt at a fresh start, but what is done in the dark always come to light.

programme.title: Bottle Girl
programme.desc: Diamond's dream of going to college is threatened by financial hardship. A desperate job at a glamorous Atlanta lounge exposes her to a world of temptation and danger. Can she navigate the high-stakes world of money, drugs, and sex, or will it consume her?

programme.title: The Bayou City Murders
programme.desc: Houston Police Officer Tamara Haynes takes a bold interest in recent murders of women in Houston’s South Side. However, the case are unique and have horrific similarities and there is likely a serial killer on the loose. Then a local prostitute that Tamara has connections to turns up missing, making this investigation personal. When she meets a man that she starts to fall for, the true nature of those involve becomes unmasked.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: Karmen, a successful businesswoman is secure and thriving in every part of her life, except for love. She downloads a dating app and seems to have found Mr. Right in Jermaine, but her best friends warn her that he might be a scammer. As Karmen falls deeper, she slowly falls victim to a network of lies and deceit, that could cost her life.

programme.title: Twisted Marriage
programme.desc: Dexter and Ashley are a married couple, who are close friends with Mary and Paul. On a whim, they decide to swing spouses for the weekend, which leads to questions about their feelings and if their marriages will survive.

programme.title: Guilty Victim
programme.desc: A dangerous investor with a violent past is pulled back into chaos when a home security scheme spirals out of control, forcing him to confront old wounds, betrayal, and a brutal fight to protect what little he has left.

programme.desc: Pop music is in the house!; featuring big artists from the 80s through the early 00s, including Michael Jackson, Madonna, Britney Spears, Justin Timberlake, Coldplay and more.

programme.title: Blues Brothers 2000
programme.desc: Newly released from prison, Elwood Blues (Dan Aykroyd) reassembles the Blues Brothers Band with new members (John Goodman, Joe Morton).","large":"The now-brotherless Ellwood Blues (Dan Aykroyd) is finally out of prison, attempting to reunite the old band and find a few new partners in crime (John Goodman), (J. Evan Bonifant). In this sequel to the original "Blues Brothers" comedy/musical, Ellwood battles the Chicago police, sings and dances his way out of numerous sticky situations, and manages to get the old band on the road for a hair-raising adventure.

programme.title: Bird on a Wire
programme.desc: An FBI-relocated witness (Mel Gibson) and his ex-girlfriend (Goldie Hawn) from the '60s are chased by the drug thug (David Carradine) he sent to prison.","large":"Rick Jarmin (Mel Gibson) is put in witness protection after he helps the FBI bust drug dealer Eugene Sorenson (David Carradine). Fifteen years later, he is living with a new identity as a gas station attendant in Detroit. When an old flame named Marianne (Goldie Hawn) stops at the gas station and recognizes him, his cover gets blown. The recently released Sorenson finds out, and both Jarmin and Marianne have to flee across the country with the vengeful Sorenson in hot pursuit.

programme.title: Serial Mom
programme.desc: A seemingly perfect wife and mother (Kathleen Turner) from Baltimore gains celebrity status as a serial killer.

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Fifteen years after they were abducted by aliens, four men get a chance to take revenge when they capture one of the creatures.","large":"Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: White Noise
programme.desc: An architect (Michael Keaton) believes his dead wife (Chandra West) is using electronic devices to communicate with him.","large":"Architect Jonathan Rivers (Michael Keaton) is happily married to author Anna (Chandra West), but tragedy strikes when she is killed in an accident. Deep in grief, Jonathan hears from Raymond Price (Ian McNeice), who claims that he has intercepted messages from Anna via electronic voice phenomena. Jonathan eventually comes to believe Raymond's claims, but, as he is drawn further into investigating the phenomenon, a sinister supernatural presence invades his life.

programme.title: White Noise 2: The Light
programme.desc: After nearly being killed along with his family, a man recovers and realizes that he can sense when someone is about to die.","large":"A man's family is killed, but he survives -- barely. After recovering, he realizes that he has changed in some way: He now senses when someone is about to die. In his attempts to save people who are near death, he discovers there is a price to pay for interfering with the cosmos.

programme.title: The New Daughter
programme.desc: A single father (Kevin Costner) is puzzled by his daughter's (Ivana Baquero) weird behavior, which begins soon after he moves his family to a secluded woodland home.

programme.title: Mama
programme.desc: As a woman (Jessica Chastain) tries to reintroduce her lover's (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) traumatized nieces to a normal life, disturbing questions and occurrences suggest that a supernatural presence has followed the girls to her home.","large":"On the day that their parents die, sisters Lilly and Victoria vanish in the woods, prompting a frantic search by their Uncle Lucas (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) and his girlfriend, Annabel (Jessica Chastain). Five years later, miraculously, the girls are found alive in a decaying cabin, and Lucas and Annabel welcome them into their home. But as Annabel tries to reintroduce the children to a normal life, she finds that someone -- or something -- still wants to tuck them in at night.

programme.title: The Unborn
programme.desc: With the help of a spiritualist (Gary Oldman), a woman (Odette Yustman) uncovers a family curse dating back to Nazi Germany and involving a demonic spirit with the power to inhabit anything or anyone.","large":"Plagued by nightmares and visitations from tortured ghosts, Casey Beldon turns to a spiritual adviser named Sendak for help. They discover a family curse that dates back to Nazi Germany: an evil spirit that can take over the body of anyone and is getting stronger with each possession, as it tries to gain full entrance to this world.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: While investigating the disappearance of her twin sister, a young American encounters the tormented spirits of Japan's mysterious and legendary Aokigahara Forest.","large":"When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Dead Silence
programme.desc: After his wife meets a grisly end, a man (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their haunted hometown and uncovers a supernatural link to her death.","large":"After his wife meets a grisly end, Jamie Ashen (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their creepy hometown of Ravens Fair to unravel the mystery of her murder. Once there, he discovers the legend of Mary Shaw (Joan Heney), a murdered ventriloquist whose eerie presence still looms over the town. As he desperately digs for answers, Jamie encounters the curse that took his wife's life and threatens his own.

programme.title: Unfriended
programme.desc: A teenager (Shelley Hennig) and her five friends (Moses Storm, Renee Olstead) become the prey of an unknown online presence that wants revenge for a shaming video that caused a classmate to kill herself one year prior.","large":"One night, while teenagers Blaire, Mitch, Jess, Adam Ken and Val take part in an online group chat session, they are suddenly joined by a user known only as "Billie227." Thinking it's just a technical glitch, the friends carry on their conversation... until Blaire begins receiving messages from someone claiming to be Laura Barns, a classmate who killed herself exactly one year prior. As Blaire tries to expose Billie's identity, her friends are forced to confront their darkest secrets and lies.

programme.title: Black Christmas
programme.desc: As sorority sisters prepare for holiday parties, a mysterious cloaked figure starts to leave a bloody trail throughout their campus. Refusing to become victims, the girls decide to band together and fight back against the psychotic Christmas killer.","large":"Hawthorne College is quieting down for the holidays as students travel home to spend time with their families. But as Riley and her sorority sisters prepare to deck the halls with seasonal parties, a mysterious cloaked figure starts to leave a bloody trail throughout the campus. Refusing to become hapless victims, Riley and her friends decide to band together and fight back against the psychotic Christmas killer.

programme.title: Nocturnal Animals
programme.desc: A writer (Jake Gyllenhaal) asks his ex-wife (Amy Adams) to read a manuscript of his new novel, a troubling story about a family man whose life takes a dark turn.","large":"A successful Los Angeles art-gallery owner's idyllic life is marred by the constant traveling of her handsome second husband. While he is away, she is shaken by the arrival of a manuscript written by her first husband, who she has not seen in years. The manuscript tells the story of a teacher who finds a trip with his family turning into a nightmare. As Susan reads the book, it forces her to examine her past and confront some dark truths.

programme.title: Children of Men
programme.desc: When infertility threatens mankind with extinction, a disillusioned bureaucrat becomes the unlikely champion in the fight for the survival of Earth's population.","large":"When infertility threatens mankind with extinction and the last child born has perished, a disillusioned bureaucrat (Clive Owen) becomes the unlikely champion in the fight for the survival of Earth's population; He must face down his own demons and protect the planet's last remaining hope from danger.

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Fifteen years after they were abducted by aliens, four men get a chance to take revenge when they capture one of the creatures.","large":"Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: Walk of Shame
programme.desc: A woman's dream of becoming a news anchor is jeopardized by an ill-advised tryst that leaves her stranded in downtown Los Angeles with no money or transportation and only eight hours to make it to the most important job interview of her life.","large":"Meghan (Elizabeth Banks) is an aspiring news anchor in the cutthroat world of Los Angeles television. After an audition for her dream job ends in failure, she goes out for an uncharacteristic night of partying. The next morning, she awakes in a stranger's bed and hears a phone message from her agent telling her the job is hers if she can make it across town by 5:00 pm. Stranded in an unknown area without money, phone or transportation, she races to the most important interview of her life.

programme.title: Trainwreck
programme.desc: A promiscuous magazine writer considers monogamy for the first time when she starts to fall in love with the charming sports doctor she's profiling.","large":"Ever since her father drilled into her head that monogamy isn't realistic, magazine writer Amy has made promiscuity her credo. As much as she enjoys an uninhibited life free of commitment, Amy is really in a rut. While writing a profile about charming and successful sports doctor Aaron Conners, she finds herself actually falling in love for the first time, and what's more, Aaron seems to like her too. Amy starts to wonder if it's time to clean up her act.

programme.title: American Pie 2
programme.desc: Old friends gather after their freshman year in college to rent a summerhouse on Lake Michigan and chase girls.","large":"After a year apart - attending different schools, meeting different people - the guys rent a beach house and vow to make this the best summer ever. As it turns out, whether that will happen or not has a lot to do with the girls. Between the wild parties, outrageous revelations and yes, a trip to band camp, they discover that times change and people change, but in the end, it's all about sticking together.

programme.title: Chinese Zodiac
programme.desc: A treasure hunter (Jackie Chan) and his team set out on a global quest to find a set of Chinese zodiac bronze heads that were stolen from a Beijing palace in the 19th century.

programme.title: Trespass
programme.desc: Two Arkansas firefighters (Bill Paxton, William Sadler) have a shootout over gold with a crime lord's (Ice-T) gang in a factory.","large":"Firefighters Vince (Bill Paxton) and Don (William Sadler) venture into gang-infested territory to find gold that's been hidden inside an abandoned building. But when they witness a murder, they become the targets of crime lord King James (Ice-T) and his underling Savon (Ice Cube). Fortunately, the treasure hunters have kidnapped a bargaining chip: King James' half-brother, Lucky (Devoreaux White). But this might not be enough to get them -- and their gold -- out of the building intact.

programme.title: Smokin' Aces
programme.desc: Two FBI agents (Ray Liotta, Ryan Reynolds) must protect an entertainer (Jeremy Piven) from a motley crew of assassins after the guy agrees to testify against the Las Vegas mob.","large":"Sleazy entertainer Buddy "Aces" Israel incurs the wrath of crime boss Primo Sparazza when he agrees to testify against the Las Vegas mob. Two FBI agents have the difficult task of protecting him from a motley assortment of bounty hunters, hit men and nefarious vixens who are converging on his Lake Tahoe encampment to rub him out and collect a hefty reward.

programme.title: They Live
programme.desc: When two men (Roddy Piper, Keith David) put on special sunglasses they see aliens and subliminal messages.","large":"Nada (Roddy Piper), a wanderer without meaning in his life, discovers a pair of sunglasses capable of showing the world the way it truly is. As he walks the streets of Los Angeles, Nada notices that both the media and the government are comprised of subliminal messages meant to keep the population subdued, and that most of the social elite are skull-faced aliens bent on world domination. With this shocking discovery, Nada fights to free humanity from the mind-controlling aliens.

programme.title: The Watcher
programme.desc: A traumatized FBI agent (James Spader) comes out of hiding to catch a serial killer (Keanu Reeves) who sends him pictures of his intended victims before he strikes.","large":"The Watcher is an exciting psychological thriller that takes a unique look into the minds of both a serial killer and the man who must, reluctantly, pursue him. In an almost Hitchcockian way, the film quickly introduces us to the killer, David Allen Griffin, played by Keanu Reeves, who for many years, preyed on lonely young women in the Los Angeles area. The story is set up to create a taut cat-and-mouse game between Griffin and FBI agent Joel Campbell.

programme.title: Captive State
programme.desc: Gabriel is a young man who joins a resistance group that's fighting back against extraterrestrial occupation of Chicago. He soon finds himself under careful scrutiny from a shadowy figure who's trying to crush the rebellion and its plans for freedom.","large":"After 10 years of extraterrestrial occupation, residents of Chicago must decide whether to continue to live under alien rule or support the resistance. When young Gabriel Drummond joins the insurgency, he soon finds himself under careful scrutiny from a shadowy figure who's trying to crush the rebellion and its plans for freedom.

programme.title: 3ABN Sabbath School Panel
programme.desc: Lesson 5 explores the concept of divine wrath as an expression of God's love. God's anger is directed against evil, injustice, and oppression, not out of arbitrary malice but in defense of His creation. Divine wrath is a loving response to the harm caused by sin, which hurts those God loves. Though God is slow to anger and abundant in compassion, His wrath is ultimately a righteous reaction to evil. Jesus also displayed righteous indignation, highlighting God's deep concern for justice. Christ’s atonement reconciles divine justice with mercy, offering salvation to believers from God's righteous judgment.

programme.desc: This week’s lesson emphasizes the inseparable connection between God's love and justice. Unlike the so-called gods of ancient paganism, who were fickle and cruel, Yahweh is unchanging in His goodness, deeply concerned with righteousness, and opposed to evil, injustice, and oppression. God's moral character is perfect and constant, as demonstrated in passages like Deuteronomy 32:4 and James 1:17. The lesson explores how divine justice and mercy intertwine, highlighting that God's judgment against evil brings deliverance for the oppressed. It challenges believers to reflect God's love and justice in their own lives.

programme.desc: Acompañe al pastor Bohr en esta nueva serie "Certeza y Paz en Tiempos Dificiles", una serie de 10 temas donde se tratará esta importante temática.

programme.title: Me gustaría saber
programme.desc: Preguntas frecuentes sobre temas doctrinales, teológicos y prácticos respondidas con base en la Biblia y el Espíritu de Profecía.

programme.title: Reflexión 360
programme.sub-title: ¿Vale la pena el sacrificio por una educación adventista?
programme.desc: En Reflexión 360 analizamos los temas más relevantes de la actualidad desde una perspectiva bíblica. Este podcast está diseñado para jó venes y adultos que desean entender los eventos del mundo a la luz de la Palabra de Dios.

programme.title: Ancla 2018: El mensaje de los tres angeles
programme.sub-title: El vino de la ira de Dios
programme.desc: En esta clase de 20 sesiones estudiaremos frase por frase los mensajes de los tres ángeles. La iglesia adventista existe por una sola razón y es para proclamar estos mensajes, pero para proclamarlos necesitamos comprenderlos. Al concluir la clase usted tendrá las herramientas necesarias para explicar con lujo de detalles el mensaje final de Dios para este tiempo.

programme.title: El poder oculto de la música
programme.sub-title: El poder de la música (Parte 3): Balada, rhythm & blues, música latina
programme.desc: Serie de Oliver Coronado sobre el impacto espiritual y emocional de la música contemporánea en el culto.

programme.title: Cómo Vencer El Pecado
programme.sub-title: Cómo Vencer El Último Gran Pecado De La Humanidad
programme.desc: Dios presenta en la Biblia que el pecado es el más grande problema en el universo; pero también revela claves que le permiten al hombre vencerlo. "Al vencedor le concederé que se siente conmigo en mi trono, así como yo he vencido y me he sentado con mi Padre en su trono." Apocalipsis 3:21.

programme.title: Voces y senales del tiempo del fin
programme.sub-title: Efectos De La Iglesia En Su Epoca Temprana
programme.desc: Orador: Jorge E. Rico, PhD En la medida que nos acercamos a la venida del Señor, las profecías de Apocalipsis toman más relevancia para sus lectores. En forma particular, el Señor le reveló a Juan eventos sin precedentes en el mundo religioso y político que afectarán a todos los habitantes de la tierra y se encuentran registrados en los capítulos 12-14. En forma profunda y con un lenguaje sencillo, el Dr. Jorge E. Rico explica esta sección de Apocalipsis para que todos puedan tener la oportunidad de entender estos mensajes especiales y prepararse para estar de pie a la venida de Cristo Jesús.

programme.title: Cambiando la Verdad por la Mentira
programme.sub-title: Cambiando la Verdad por la Mentira - Parte 9 de 10

programme.title: Descubriendo los misterios de Génesis
programme.desc: Descubriendo los Misterios de Génesis es un estudio sobre el principio y el fin en la Biblia que tiene como propósito explicar las grandes profecías de la Biblia desde la perspectiva del libro de Génesis. Usted se maravillará por la forma clara, sencilla y profunda en que el Pastor Esteban Bohr explica estas profecías.

programme.title: Conéctate con Dios
programme.sub-title: Lecciones de un niño de seis años
programme.desc: La serie Conéctate Con Dios te invita a aplicar enseñanzas bíblicas al diario vivir, aún en los detalles más pequeños se puede ver las maravillas de nuestro Creador. Excelente para compartir con su iglesia, grupos de estudio bíblico y con los jóvenes también.

programme.title: Tiempo de decisión
programme.desc: Mensajes que resaltan el llamado urgente de Dios a la salvación y la entrega personal. Pastor Luis Ernesto Prieto.

programme.title: Los Secretos Del Pentecostes
programme.sub-title: Pr. Bohr - El Don De Lenguas En Hechos
programme.desc: La mayoría de la gente piensa en un viento impetuoso, lenguas de fuego y lenguas extrañas. Pero hay mucho más en Pentecostés que esto. En esta serie de 12 partes, el Pastor Bohr explica el profundo significado de los eventos pentecostales en el cielo y en la tierra y su significado para el día de hoy. Hay un vínculo indisoluble entre la obra que cumplió Cristo en la tierra y el derramamiento del Espíritu Santo en el día del Pentecosté s. Esperamos seas bendecido con el estudio de estos 12 temas con el pastor Esteban Bohr.

programme.title: Costa Rica: un futuro con esperanza
programme.sub-title: Qué haces aquí? – Pr. David Salazar

programme.title: Textos Dificiles Sobre El Estado De Los Muertos

Usted se sorprenderá al ver como muchos cristianos de hoy explican erradamente ciertos versículos.

programme.title: Danny Johnson
programme.desc: Danny Johnson's hilarious, clean stand-up has entertained audiences in comedy clubs, corporate events, and churches nationwide. Often called a cross between Jerry Seinfeld and Kevin James Danny's show is relatable, engaging, and always hilarious. Danny has starred in numerous TV commercials, Comedy Central's Laugh Riots, Florida's Funniest Comedian semi-finalist, Winner-Carnival Cruise line Comedy Challenge, Finalist in Search for the One Christian Comedy contest, and has had the pleasure of sharing the stage with Chris Rock, Bob Saget, Billy Gardell, Richard Lewis, and a variety of others. Danny has led a dual track career for over a decade achieving success in both corporate America and as a comedian. Blending his unique skill sets led to him publishing his first book, "You Stink and They Know It! A practical guide to nailing your next job interview."

programme.title: Eric O Shea
programme.desc: Eric O'Shea has been active in the comedy business for 25 years. He has performed in L.A. with Betty White at the Creative Emmy Awards and has appeared on America's Got Talent TV Show. Every year since 1997, Eric has performed an average of 70 shows a year, and has received 7 nominations as the “National College Comedian of the Year”

programme.title: Mike Burton
programme.desc: Mike Burton delivers his comedy with high energy, great storytelling, and hilarious facial expressions. Mike started his stand-up comedy career in 1996 first performing in the local clubs in NYC, then gaining nationwide popularity. He has been on TV shows, independent feature films, and commercials for HP and Modells. Mike has also performed in daytime shows: Rachel Ray, The Chew, and ABC's The Revolution.

programme.title: Erica Rhodes
programme.desc: Erica Rhodes is a regular panelist on Comedy Central's @midnight and Fox's Punchline. She has made appearances on SeeSo's The Guest List, Hulu's Coming to the Stage, AXS' Live at Gotham and the syndicated Comics Unleashed. Erica has performed at San Francisco Sketchfest, the Moontower Comedy Festival (Austin, TX), the Blue Whale Comedy Festival (Tulsa, OK), the Boston Comedy Festival and RIOT LA Fest. Recent TV credits include ABC's Modern Family, HBO's Veep, Fox's New Girl, and IFC's Comedy Bang Bang. Erica stars in Audible's Dr. Katz: The Audio Files and ABC Digital's The Off Season. She recurs on TruTV's Fameless and has been a semi-regular performer/writer on NPR's A Prairie Home Companion.

programme.desc: 1997. John (John C. Reilly), um fracassado encalhado em Reno, está duro. programme.desc: 2008. Uma amizade proibida se forma entre Bruno, o filho de um comandante nazista, e Schmuel, um menino judeu mantido prisioneiro em um campo de concentração. Gêneros: Drama Elenco: Asa Butterfield, Domonkos Németh, Henry Kingsmill, Vera Farmiga, Cara Horgan Diretor: Mark Herman

programme.title: A Qualquer Preço
programme.desc: 1998. O advogado especialista em danos pessoais Jan só aceita grandes casos que sejam resolvidos com segurança fora do tribunal. Embora o caso mais recente pareça simples, ele se envolve em uma batalha épica, na qual está disposto arristar sua carreira. Gêneros: Drama Elenco: John Travolta, Robert Duvall, Kathleen Quinlan Diretor: Steven Zaillian

programme.title: Marcados Pela Guerra
programme.desc: 2014. Uma jovem decide se alistar no exército na esperança de ser mandada para o Iraque, onde entraria em contato com uma nova cultura. Ela acaba, no entanto, sendo realocada para Guantánamo, onde se depara com uma rotina de ódio e abuso. Gêneros: Drama Elenco: Stewart, Kristen, Garrison, Liane Diretor: Peter Sattler

programme.title: A Vingança de John Henry
programme.desc: 2020. Quando duas crianças imigrantes que fogem de seu exlíder de gangue, tropeçam em sua vida, John é forçado a se reconciliar com seu passado para tentar darlhes um futuro. Gêneros: Action & Adventure Elenco: Terry Crews, Ludacris, Maestro Harrell, Kimberly Hebert Gregory, Ken Foree, Gerald Slink Johnson, Dohn Norwood, Tyler Alvarez, Jamila Velazquez, Josep... Diretor: Will Forbes, William Forbes

programme.title: O Ilusionista
programme.desc: 2006. Na Viena de 1900, um mágico usa suas habilidades para proteger o amor de uma mulher muito acima de sua posição social Gêneros: Drama Elenco: Biel, Edward, Giamatti, Jessica, Norton, Paul, Edward Norton, Jessica Biel, Paul Giamatti, Rufus Sewell Diretor: Neil Burger

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: The Journey Begins
programme.desc: Følg med og se hvem som kommer til å klare de vanskeligste danseuttakene i sportsverdenen. 500 kvinner satser alt for drømmen om å bli en av de berømte Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders for 2014-2015-sesongen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Dancing For Your Life
programme.desc: 55 jenter i toppklasse har kommet seg til finalen, noe som bekymrer de 30 veteranene som nå må kjempe for en plass i troppen. Kitty Carter holder ikke tilbake når hun forbereder jentene på å danse sine soloer.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Welcome to Valley Ranch
programme.desc: Når treningsleiren åpner med 43 kvinner, blir presset stort! Kellis entusiasme er smittsom, men det første møtet er også opprørende. Forventningene er skyhøye. Syv jenter må eliminieres for at troppen skal bestå av 36.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: A Week Of Firsts
programme.desc: Frykt griper treningsleirkandidatene når de innser at de må klare DCCs benspark og hoppspagat for første gang. Å lande så unaturlig krever stor tro på seg selv.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Getting The DCC Look
programme.desc: For å være en DCC må man se ut som en DCC. Denne uken skal Kelli sørge for at alle jentene har den rette looken. De begynner med en makeover og jentene drar til snobbete Halcyon Salon for å få nye frisyrer.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Time To Get Serious
programme.desc: Kandidatene starter sin sjette uke og de må begynne å se ut som DCC, eller så kan de risikere å miste plassene sine. Melissa Rycroft og tidligere DCC Tina Kalina vikarierer for Judy og Kelli for å se kandidatene med nye øyne.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: A Lucid Dream
programme.desc: Det er tre jenter igjen å sende hjem og den første kampen er rett rundt hjørnet, så trykket er enormt når jentene vender tilbake til AT&T Stadium for å innta banen for første gang siden uttaket.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: The Payoff
programme.desc: Det er treningsleirens siste dag og alle er nervøse for at Kelli og Judy skal velge ut en tropp med færre enn 36 medlemmer. Etter noen tøffe beslutninger forvandles skrekk til glede når sluttroppen kunngjøres.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Dare To Dream
programme.desc: Denne sesongen har 400 jenter våget å drømme stort at de kan bli en av de verdensberømte Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders. De satser alt når de preliminære uttakene for 2015-2016-troppen begynner.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Dance Your Heart Out
programme.desc: Tjuetre veteraner melder seg på uttaket for å konkurrere mot 59 nybegynnere som vil ta plassene deres. Talent og utseende er ikke nok for å sikre en plass i troppen. Drømmer både går i oppfyllelse og knuses når kun 46 kommer seg til leiren.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: An Emotional Beginning
programme.desc: Treningsleiren begynner og Kelli sier hvor skapet skal stå. Noen av jentene bryter sammen når de innser hvor vanskelig det er å bli en DCC. Melissa Rycroft gir dem håp og råd om hvordan de skal klare seg.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: The Cuts Begin
programme.desc: Kelli og Judy må sende ti jenter hjem for å komme ned til troppens magiske 36. Tilpassingen av drakter viser Kelli hvem som har alt. Når de begynner å sende folk hjem, knuses drømmer.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Becoming World Class
programme.desc: Jentene får DCC-looken, som er til hjelp for noen, men ikke andre. To gjester overrasker på treningen og rocker DCCs verden. Kelli opplever en av de pinligste kontorsbesøkene noensinne.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Having A Bad Day
programme.desc: Cameo- og showgruppe-uttak presser de nye og veteranene til bristepunktet. Melissa Rycroft forsøker å redde en DCC som henger i en tynn tråd, og et besøk på Kellis kontor avsluttes på en sjokkerende måte.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: The Cutting Board
programme.desc: Følelsene stormer når Kelli og Judy må ta vanskelige valg og sende folk hjem for å beholde troppens kvalitet. Melissa Rycroft deler ut uvurderlige råd.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Living the Dream
programme.desc: Kelli kunngjør endelig troppen. Skader truer starten på Cowboys treningsleir. Kaos på kampdagen kan ødelegge for jentene når opptredenen må være feilfri.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Drømmen starter
programme.desc: Hundrevis av vakre og talentfulle håpefulle ankommer for å prøve å bli verdens beste heiagjeng. Samtidig søker mange av jentene som må dra, forsoning.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Nydebut-jentene
programme.desc: Veteranene kjemper for plassene mens de nye prøver å leve drømmene og gjennomgå treningsleiren til DCC. De stilles overfor panelintervjuer, soloer, en slitsom dansekombinasjon og et rom med tøffe dommere.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Dette er sværingene
programme.desc: De nye kandidatene får en tankevekker om hva det innebærer å være en DCC. Jentene kjemper for å lære dansene. Melissa Rycroft treffer nykommerne for første gang.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Time to Push
programme.desc: With the first cut looming, the girls must push their dance skills to the limit; Melissa Rycroft works to bring out showmanship; stress increases on makeover day as the girls try to get the DCC look.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Big Surprises
programme.desc: A new choreographer shakes things up; uniform fittings and the Belk fashion show approach; two-time Grammy winner Kacey Musgraves stops by rehearsal.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Brouille

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Création
programme.desc: Les garçons répètent avant de se produire au Nelly's le soir même. Tout le monde est emballé par la musique de leur nouvelle mélodie et Adeline propose d'écrire les paroles...

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Patience
programme.desc: Pour se faire pardonner, José envoie des fleurs à Béné. Il la retrouve à la cafèt' et lui demande de revenir avec lui. Prétextant qu'elle ne l'aime plus, Béné refuse. Alors que José repart, furieux.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Le fait accompli
programme.desc: Le percolateur que José vient d'acheter explose. Sébastien est blessé à la main et Laly s'empresse de lui faire un pansement. Alors que Sébastien, très troublé, confie à Nicolas qu'il aime encore Laly.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Retour aux sources
programme.desc: Alors qu'Hélène reproche à Laly de n'avoir toujours pas parlé à Laurent, ce dernier arrive à la cafèt'. Les filles le laissent en tête-à-tête avec Laly. Après une explication, ils décident de rester bons amis.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Passé compliqué
programme.desc: José arrive au garage, très perturbé. Olivier aperçoit un journal qui dépasse de sa poche et essaye de le lui prendre. José se fâche mais Olivier réussit à arracher la première page : c'est une revue érotique...

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: La honte
programme.desc: Adeline se confie à Hélène qui lui avoue connaître son secret. Cette dernière lui conseille de prévenir rapidement sa mère tandis qu'au garage et à la cafèt' les photos circulent...

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Sale
programme.desc: La fuite d'Adeline perturbe toute la bande, Laly fait même un cauchemar prémonitoire dans lequel Adeline se noie. L'angoisse fait souffler un vent de folie dans les esprits...

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Rédemption
programme.desc: Laly et Sébastien dégustent le bonheur de leurs retrouvailles mais Sébastien déchante en apprenant le retour de Linda. A la cafèt', les railleries sur Adeline vont bon train : Bruno fou de rage cherche la bagarre.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Renouveau
programme.desc: L'humeur est à la joie pour Linda qui rapporte des Bahamas un amour de vacances, et pour Sébastien, soulagé de sa réaction. De son côté, Laly, rayonnante, décide de prendre en main le bonheur de ses amis...

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: La drague folle
programme.desc: Laly obtient la promesse de Bénédicte de se réconcilier avec José et veut maintenant trouver de jolies filles pour Olivier. Nathalie fait quant à elle une étrange proposition aux garçons...

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Erreur de calcul
programme.desc: Laly est encore préoccupée par la réconciliation de Bénédicte et José. Olivier confie aux garçons que la seule fille qui l'intéresse, Inke, est avec José. Ce dernier exulte et tire un trait sur Bénédicte.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Incursions
programme.desc: À la cafèt', Olivier sympathise avec Taxi, une jeune fille attrayante. À la salle de gym, Laly et Bénédicte sont les témoins d'une rixe. Bouleversées par l'état de la victime, Fabrice, elles l'emmènent au garage pour le soigner.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Mystérieux
programme.desc: Hélène prépare ses examens et les filles critiquent Taxi, qui est plus appréciée par Olivier que par Laly ! Néanmoins, Taxi les étonne tous par ses gratifications, mais la révélation de Fabrice est plus surprenante encore...

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: La bague
programme.desc: Les garçons rendent les vêtements subtilisés par Taxi qui offre un médaillon à Olivier. Mais après que celle-ci soit passée chez les filles, Laly s'aperçoit de la disparition de sa bague en or.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Théâtral
programme.desc: Fabrice accompagne Bénédicte à son cours de théâtre attisant ainsi la jalousie de José. Taxi arrive à la cafèt' avec les garçons chez qui elle a passé la nuit. Nathalie, éplorée, s'ouvre à Hélène au sujet de José.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Décision
programme.desc: Bénédicte décide de déménager mais se rend compte qu'elle ne pourra assumer la charge d'un appartement. Fabrice lui propose de vivre avec Taxi et lui, sans résultat.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Progression
programme.desc: Alors que les garçons parlementent à propos de la liaison de Nathalie et José, Taxi poursuivie par la police arrive chez eux, affolée. Olivier tente de la convaincre d'arrêter de voler d'une manière qui laisse ses amis stupéfaits...

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Une nuit dehors
programme.desc: Taxi surprend Bénédicte chez son frère après qu'ils aient passé la nuit ensemble. Bénédicte rentre chez les filles et leur fait signe de ne rien dire à Laly qui dort encore, mais Taxi vend la mèche et Laly est furieuse...

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Le grigri brésilien
programme.desc: Laly est très fière du porte-bonheur qu'elle vient de recevoir de sa tante brésilienne. Mais la malchance s'abat sur elle ainsi que sur Fabrice et Sébastien qui l'ont aussi porté.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Une fille qui a du chien
programme.sub-title: Une fille qui a du chien
programme.desc: Bien décidée à ne plus voler, Taxi trouve un emploi de garde de chiens ! Accompagnée de sa meute dévastatrice, elle se rend au garage pour demander aux garçons de la garder le temps de leur acheter à manger.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Détournement
programme.desc: Alors que José est à la cafèt' avec Nathalie et Isabelle, une de ses amies, un garçon s'approche de lui pour lui faire une proposition importante. Laly quant à elle, a un bien étrange problème...

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Désertion
programme.desc: Les garçons sont agacés des retards de José aux répétitions et Nathalie, paniquée, annonce à Hélène qu'il veut quitter le groupe et renier ses copains... Hélène fonce au Nelly's prévenir Nicolas.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Remplacement
programme.desc: José, refusant de jouer avec ses amis, compromet le gala que les garçons doivent donner au Nelly's. De plus, le remplaçant proposé par Taxi s'avère incompétent.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Une fille chez les gars
programme.desc: Tout le monde se félicite du triomphe de Laly au Nelly's. Mais la joie de la bande est de courte durée lorsque les musiciens du nouveau groupe de José viennent récupérer son synthétiseur.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Un nouveau garçon
programme.desc: Laly doit poser pour Roberto mais, handicapée par une séance d'UV qui tourne mal, le photographe ne peut faire que des clichés de sa silhouette dans le noir ! Au garage, Adeline arrive avec sa nouvelle conquête...

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Le déserteur
programme.desc: Olivier n'est pas rentré dormir et les garçons le croient avec Taxi. Mais cette dernière leur téléphone pour lui parler. Quand Olivier arrive au garage, il annonce qu'il part en tournée avec le groupe de José...

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Le mauvais œil
programme.desc: Laly a la certitude que quelqu'un vient de jeter le mauvais œil sur la bande. Elle cherche un exorciseur pendant que les garçons essayent de recruter de nouveaux musiciens.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Supplique

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 2

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 3
programme.desc: Isa était heureuse d'avoir retrouvé la vie de famille auprès de son fils et de sa mère. Malheureusement, son oncle Marcel était repris par ses démons. Il la suivait partout, l'épiait, et avait parfois des gestes fugitifs...

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 4

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 5
programme.desc: Isa a repris confiance en la vie quand Julia Bertyl l’engage comme habilleuse. Malheureusement, la grande cantatrice en perdant sa voix, a aussi perdu la raison...

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 6
programme.desc: Pour remplacer Isa auprès de Julia, Arnaud a fait venir des USA Audrey, sa fille adoptive qui rêve de devenir cantatrice. De son côté, Isa a été profondément humiliée d'avoir été bannie de La Réserve.

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 7
programme.desc: Marc a donc épousé Isa. Hélène tente de faire bonne figure, mais intérieurement elle est brisée. Christian essaie d'oublier son amour impossible pour Isa dans les bras d'Audrey.

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 8
programme.desc: Le diagnostic est tombé : Marc restera totalement paralysé à vie. Surmontant sa peine, Isa s'installe près de lui à l'hôpital et s'en occupe nuit et jour. Même Hélène l'admire et pourtant elle la hait viscéralement.

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 9
programme.desc: Traumatisée par la mort de Marc, Isa a perdu l'enfant qu'elle attendait de lui. Elle était décidée à refuser l'héritage, mais comme Hélène agit d'une manière ignoble avec elle, elle change d'avis.

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 10
programme.desc: Le résultat de l'autopsie tombe : Marc a été empoisonné. La Juge est intimement convaincue qu'Isa a aidé son mari à mourir mais doit le prouver. Elle interroge scrupuleusement tout son entourage et dresse un portrait psychologique de la suspecte...

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 11
programme.desc: Isa a été inculpée et mise en prison. Elle refuse de prendre un avocat pour se défendre malgré l'insistance de Christian et Patricia qui lui rendent souvent visite.

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 12
programme.desc: Le jour du procès d'Isa approche. Arnaud, qui ignore encore qu'Isa est sa fille, pousse Geneviève à lui rendre visite en prison avec Tanguy. La mère et la fille sont bouleversées de se retrouver. Elles font la paix...

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 13
programme.desc: Isa a en possession la lettre qui accuse Hélène d’avoir été l’instigatrice de la mort de Marc. Plus rien ne peut arrêter son ascension. Elle efface un passé douloureux en rejetant son oncle Marcel taraudé par le remords de l’avoir violée.

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 14
programme.desc: Audrey, délaissée par Christian, s'ennuie de plus en plus à La Réserve. Elle ne veut pas reprendre le chant. De son côté, Sylvain fait tout pour reconquérir Isa.

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 15
programme.desc: Hélène a désormais tous les moyens pour se venger d'Isa, mais elle est totalement dépendante physiquement de Sylvain.

programme.title: Les cœurs brûlés: Épisode 16
programme.desc: Christian qui s’est marié par désespoir révèle ses véritables sentiments à Isa qui reste sourde à ses avances. Hélène de son côté, est tombée sous la coupe de Sylvain qui se joue d’elle...
